Retry-After.description: Whole seconds to wait before retrying. Never on quota_exceeded.

X-Request-Id.description: The request's ID, in every log line and its Trails event.

Cursor.description: The previous page's nextCursor. Bound to the organization, the list and its filters.
Cursor.name: cursor

IdempotencyKey.description: Makes a retry safe: the same key and request get the stored response.
IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key

Limit.description: The page size. Out of range is 400, never a clamp.
Limit.name: limit

AccessDenied.description: access_denied: the caller's policies don't allow the action; forbidden_origin: a cookie-authenticated write from an origin that isn't allowed; spend_limit_reached.

Conflict.description: quota_exceeded (an allocation quota, with quota), idempotency_conflict, idempotency_in_progress (with Retry-After), organization_deletion_pending, operation_in_progress, or the endpoint's own 409 codes.

InternalError.description: internal_error: a bug; the details are in the logs, under the request ID.

InvalidRequest.description: invalid_request (with issues), invalid_cursor, or the endpoint's own 400 codes.

NotFound.description: not_found: unknown, malformed, or in an organization the caller isn't in.

Operation.description: The operation, which Location names; poll it until it finishes.

PayloadTooLarge.description: payload_too_large: the body is over the endpoint's limit (1 MiB unless it says otherwise).

TooManyRequests.description: too_many_requests, with Retry-After; or quota_exceeded (a rate, usage or concurrency quota, with quota), never with Retry-After.

Unauthenticated.description: unauthenticated: no credential, or one that doesn't check out.

Unavailable.description: unavailable: a dependency the request needs is down. Retry after Retry-After.

failure.description: Why it failed, { code, message }; null unless failed.

secondaryGids.description: Always empty: secondary groups aren't supported.

path.description: An absolute, normalized path in the file system.

status.description: creating, available, deleting or failed; clients treat others as unknown.

secondaryGids.description: Secondary groups aren't supported: omit this or send an empty list; any group ID is 400 invalid_request.

Error.description: Every non-2xx answer. Clients branch on code, never on message.

issues.description: invalid_request: one entry per problem, at a dotted path.

failure.description: Why it failed, { code, message }; null unless failed.

sizeBytes.description: Bytes stored, measured, as a string of digits.

status.description: creating, available, deleting or failed; clients treat others as unknown.

vpc.description: The VPC (vpc_…) whose instances mount it.

failure.description: Why it failed, { code, message }; null unless failed.

hostname.description: The DNS name to mount by; null until available.

ipv4Address.description: The address in the subnet; null until available.

status.description: creating, available, deleting or failed; clients treat others as unknown.

allowedSourceCidrs.description: Where mounts may come from; the VPC's ranges when absent.

createdBy.description: Who started it: a user or bot, or the platform (service, organizations.ezghcloud.com) deleting what a deleted project or organization held.

error.description: A failed operation's error, { code, message }.

QuotaExceeded.description: quota_exceeded: the quota that refused the request. Never with Retry-After.

window.description: rate only: an ISO 8601 duration, PT1S to PT1H.

Tags.description: At most 50; keys 1-128 characters, values at most 256, keys starting with ezgh: are reserved.

apiKey.description: A customer API key: Bearer ezgh_…

oauth.description: An OAuth access token (Bearer ezgh_at_…) or an EZGH SSO resource token (Bearer ezgh_sat_…)

sessionCookie.description: A signed-in person's session, set by login.ezghcloud.com.
sessionCookie.name: __Secure-better-auth.session_token

info.description: Shared file systems for instances in a VPC, mounted over NFS 4.1. Every path is under an organization; lists are paged with limit, cursor and nextCursor.
info.title: Files API

get.summary: List the organization's operations, newest first

delete.description: 409 operation_finished or operation_not_cancellable when it can't be cancelled.

get.description: While it's queued or running, Retry-After suggests when to poll again. Not recorded in Trails.
get.summary: Get an operation (poll it until it finishes)
List a project's access points, newest first

post.description: Asynchronous: answers 202 with the operation that creates it (and its root directory, with creationInfo).

delete.description: Asynchronous: the access point goes, its files stay.

patch.description: Synchronous: name, description and tags. 400 immutable_field for rootDirectory, posixUser and fileSystem.

get.summary: List a project's file systems, newest first

post.description: Asynchronous: answers 202 with the operation that creates it.

delete.description: Asynchronous. 409 file_system_in_use while it has mount targets or access points; 409 deletion_protected while deletionProtection is on.

patch.description: Synchronous: every field is optional, and only the ones given change. 400 immutable_field for vpc.

get.summary: List a project's mount targets, newest first

post.description: Asynchronous: answers 202 with the operation that creates it. The subnet must be in the file system's VPC (409 vpc_mismatch), one per subnet per file system (409 mount_target_exists).

delete.description: Asynchronous: the address goes, the file system's files stay.

patch.description: Synchronous: allowedSourceCidrs, name and tags. 400 immutable_field for fileSystem and subnet.
